name: bunq mobile banking landing page by bunq.com
description: A near-black, photography-led landing page where the rainbow brand gradient is deliberately confined to product imagery (phone screens, payment card) and soft ambient glows, so white type and spacing carry the structure. Rhythm alternates between left-aligned editorial blocks, centered section headers, full-bleed rounded photos, a hairline-divided feature accordion, and horizontally scrolling feature cards with a peeking next slide. Trust is stacked near the end: gradient stat banners in green, blue and orange, a monochrome press strip, starred review cards, and a Personal/Business segmented plan selector.
